ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ إِمَامِ أَهْلِ حَضْرَةِ الْكَرِيْمِ الْفَتَّاحِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Imāmi ahli ḥaḍrati ‘l-karīmi ‘l-fattāḥ.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the imam of those of Generous Opener's Presence!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَاجْعَلْنَا بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْفَوْزِ وَالْفَلَاحِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa ‘j`alnā bi ‘ṣ-Ṣalāti `alayhi min ahli ‘l-fawzi wa ‘l-falāḥ.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and make us by sending prayers upon him from those of triumph and success!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ أُولِي الْفَضْلِ وَالرَّبَاحِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Ulī ‘l-faḍli wa ‘r-rabāḥ.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family, those of erudition and profit!
